result.instructions: Tools for BetterNow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which fundraisers in our charity raised the most this month?"; "Show the donations to the spring appeal fundraiser, with amounts and dates."; "List the teams in our 2026 marathon event and their goals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BetterNow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run betternow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run betternow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run betternow_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. betternow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: betternow_get_organisation
tools.title: Get an organisation
tools.description: Get one charity (organisation) by id: name, description, and links to its projects, fundraisers and donations. GET /organisations/{id}.

organisation_id.description: The id (or slug) from an earlier call.

tools.name: betternow_list_organisation_projects
tools.title: List an organisation's projects
tools.description: List the projects (campaigns) of one organisation. Paginated: 50 per range. GET /organisations/{id}/projects.

organisation_id.description: The id (or slug) from an earlier call.

range.description: Item range, for example "0-49" (50 items per range). Pass the next_range of a truncated reply to get more.

tools.name: betternow_create_fundraiser
tools.title: Create a fundraiser
tools.description: CREATES a public fundraising page for a person under a project and site. Needs fundraisers:write. Only call when the user asks for it. POST /fundraisers.

name.description: The page headline, for example 'Jane's Fundraiser for HelpNow'.

site_id.description: The site that hosts the page.

goal.description: Fundraising goal: amount in cents and a 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

fundraiser_type.description: Fundraiser type as the BetterNow site defines it.

tools.name: betternow_create_team
tools.title: Create a team
tools.description: CREATES a public fundraising team under an event and site. Needs teams:write. Only call when the user asks for it. POST /teams.

goal.description: Fundraising goal: amount in cents and a 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

tools.name: betternow_add_fundraiser_to_team
tools.title: Add a fundraiser to a team
tools.description: CHANGES a team: adds one fundraising page as a member. Needs team_memberships:write. POST /team-memberships.

annotations.title: Add a fundraiser to a team

tools.name: betternow_remove_fundraiser_from_team
tools.title: Remove a fundraiser from its team
tools.description: CHANGES a team: removes one fundraising page from its team (the page stays). Needs team_memberships:write. DELETE /team-memberships/{fundraiser_id}.

annotations.title: Remove a fundraiser from its team
